name: linkdigest
displayName: LinkDigest — Xiaohongshu, Douyin, TikTok, YouTube to text
description: Turns a Xiaohongshu, Douyin, TikTok, YouTube or X link into text the agent can read: transcript with timecodes, on-screen text, a description and OCR of every image, caption and metadata. One tool, digest_url. Hosted; nothing runs locally.
